findings.disposition_rationale: python3 probe runs with -I and every root-run child starts in /.
Path flags restricted to ^/[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+$ with no .. segment.
Tools resolved from system dirs only and custody-checked before root runs them; untrusted sudo never run.
verifyUninstallTargets checks ownership, kind, ancestors and contents before any destructive op.
doas parser matches numeric ids, joins continuations, fails closed on unknown rules.
Existing group stripped of gshadow admins and password.
/root accepted at root:root with no group or world write bits; spec updated.
Interpreter verified through every link hop; unit runs the verified literal path.
Tool custody runs before getent/id; presence detected by lstat, no shell.
Every symlink hop and its parent chain verified; literal path executed.
Literal node path kept in ExecStart for snap/BusyBox/versioned installs; reinstall checks the service is active.
Every hop of --node and its parent chain must be root-owned and tight; a node the account cannot execute fails install loudly (no fingerprint, or the reinstall is-active check).
The runner cannot swap a link whose every hop and parent directory is root-owned and not group- or world-writable.
--purge-key deletes the governor's key directory on an explicit operator request after ownership and content checks; systemctl disable --now stops the unit synchronously.
Permission and start-up failures for the commissaire account surface as a failed install (exit 1), not a silent pass.
Second-opinion output degraded into repetition and was truncated at its token budget; distinct findings above are its substantive content.
